That refinement is in and verified. On **http://maker:4001**, one quick check to close the loop on the Read later lane:

1. On a bookmark in **All**, press **"Read later"** — it gets the flag and its button becomes **"Mark as read."**
2. Switch to the **Read later** view — you see it there.
3. Press **"Mark as read."** It **drops out of the Read later view** immediately, and back in **All** it's still there, just without the flag — ready to be found by search like anything else.

This matches what you described: read-later items live in both All and their focused lane, and marking them read retires them from the lane without removing them from your collection.

**Does the Read later + Archive behaviour now feel complete and right to you?**
